title: Extend an initial horseshoe embedding to exact rows of complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $S=(A\xrightarrow{f}B\xrightarrow{g}C)$ be a short exact sequence. Fix injective resolutions $s_A:A\to I_A^\bullet$ and $s_C:C\to I_C^\bullet$, indexed by $\mathbf N$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Fix a morphism $t:B\to I_A^0$ satisfying $f\,t=s_A^0$ (diagrammatic composition order). There exist a cochain complex $K^\bullet$ indexed by $\mathbf N$, an augmentation $s_B:B[0]\to K^\bullet$, and complex maps $\alpha:I_A^\bullet\to K^\bullet$, $\beta:K^\bullet\to I_C^\bullet$ such that $s_A\alpha=f[0]s_B$, $s_B\beta=g[0]s_C$, and $\alpha\beta=0$. Each row $I_A^n\to K^n\to I_C^n$ is short exact. There is an isomorphism $e_0:K^0\simeq I_A^0\oplus I_C^0$ with $s_B^0 e_0=(t,g s_C^0)$, and the sequence $B\xrightarrow{s_B^0}K^0\xrightarrow{d_K^0}K^1$ is exact. The conclusion does not assert injectivity of $K^n$, positive-degree exactness of $K$, or that $s_B$ is a quasi-isomorphism.

proof.text: Use Mathlib ShortComplex.Exact.descToInjective for S to descend -(lift d_A^0) along g, since f lift d_A^0=s_A^0 d_A^0=0. Extend this map across the monomorphism s_C^0 using Injective.factorThru, giving t_0:I_C^0→I_A^1 with lift d_A^0+g s_C^0 t_0=0. Since g is epi, this equality implies s_C^0 t_0 d_A^1=0. Apply IC.exact₀.descToInjective to obtain t_1 with d_C^0 t_1=-t_0 d_A^1.

proof.text: Recursively keep the pair (t_n,t_(n+1)) and the equation d_C^n t_(n+1)=-t_n d_A^(n+1). Multiplying by d_A^(n+2) shows d_C^n kills -t_(n+1) d_A^(n+2). Mathlib IC.exact_succ n and Exact.descToInjective therefore give t_(n+2) satisfying the next equation. Nat.rec constructs all t_n; no unproved existence theorem supplies data.

proof.text: Set K^n=I_A^n⊕I_C^n and d_K^n=[[d_A^n,t_n],[0,d_C^n]]. Biproduct extensionality, square-zero of the outer differentials, and the recursive equation show d_K^n d_K^(n+1)=0. CochainComplex.of constructs K, and CochainComplex.ofHom assembles the canonical inclusions α and projections β. They compose to zero and every evaluated row is short exact by ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct.shortExact. The first equation shows w=(lift,g s_C^0) is killed by d_K^0. CochainComplex.fromSingle₀Equiv constructs its augmentation. The two augmentation squares follow from f lift=s_A^0 and fg=0; e_0 is Iso.refl.

proof.text: Prove degree-zero exactness using Mathlib ShortComplex.exact_iff_exact_up_to_refinements. For x:T→K^0 killed by d_K^0, its right coordinate is killed by d_C^0, hence IC.exact₀.lift gives c:T→C. Since g is epi, surjective_up_to_refinements_of_epi gives an epi π:T'→T and b:T'→B with π c=b g. Put y=π x-b w. Its right coordinate vanishes and y d_K^0=0, so its left coordinate is killed by d_A^0. IA.exact₀.lift gives a:T'→A with a s_A^0=y fst. Then (b+a f) w=π x, checked on the two biproduct projections. This proves the required exactness.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_horseshoe_prescribed_rows
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C]
    (S : ShortComplex C) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    (IA : InjectiveResolution S.X₁) (IC : InjectiveResolution S.X₃)
    (lift : S.X₂ ⟶ IA.cocomplex.X 0) (hlift : S.f ≫ lift = IA.ι.f 0) :
    ∃ (K : CochainComplex C ℕ)
      (ι : (CochainComplex.single₀ C).obj S.X₂ ⟶ K)
      (α : IA.cocomplex ⟶ K) (β : K ⟶ IC.cocomplex),
      IA.ι ≫ α = (CochainComplex.single₀ C).map S.f ≫ ι ∧
      ι ≫ β = (CochainComplex.single₀ C).map S.g ≫ IC.ι ∧
      (∃ e₀ : K.X 0 ≅ IA.cocomplex.X 0 ⊞ IC.cocomplex.X 0,
        ι.f 0 ≫ e₀.hom = biprod.lift lift (S.g ≫ IC.ι.f 0)) ∧
      (ShortComplex.mk (ι.f 0) (K.d 0 1) (by simp)).Exact ∧
      ∃ (hαβ : α ≫ β = 0), ∀ n : ℕ,
        ((ShortComplex.mk α β hαβ).map
          (HomologicalComplex.eval C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)).ShortExact
